blocks.content:
Established: 1964
Statutory Status: 2003
Anti-corruption watchdog
Supervises CBI
Tenure: 4 years / 65 years
Advisory body

items: Tenure length (4 years or 65 years of age) is frequently asked as it differs from the standard 5 or 6-year terms.
Questions often test the year statutory status was granted (2003) versus the establishment year (1964).
The supervisory authority over CBI is a recurring competitive exam question.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The body was originally established in 1964 as an advisory entity.
It was granted statutory status later in the year 2003.
It serves as a primary anti-corruption watchdog.
It exercises supervision over the functioning of the CBI.
Members hold office for a tenure of 4 years or until reaching 65 years of age.
